text: The brake controller shall apply full braking pressure within 150 ms of an emergency brake request.
The brake controller shall apply full braking pressure within 300 ms of an emergency brake request.
The brake system shall be reliable.
The ABS shall prevent wheel lock-up on dry asphalt at speeds up to 200 km/h.
The brake warning lamp shall be activated when the brake fluid level is below the minimum mark.
The brake controller shall log every ABS intervention and/or ESC intervention.
The parking brake shall hold the vehicle on a 20% gradient.
The brake controller shall not release the parking brake while the engine is off.
When an emergency brake request is received, the brake controller shall reach full braking pressure in 150 ms or less.
The brake pedal feel should be comfortable for the driver.
The infusion pump shall deliver the programmed volume with an accuracy of ±5%.
The infusion pump shall sound an occlusion alarm within 30 s of a downstream occlusion.
The occlusion alarm shall be sounded within 60 s of a downstream occlusion.
The infusion pump shall be easy to program for nurses.
The infusion pump shall store the last 1000 alarms, events, etc.
The infusion pump shall resume infusion after a power failure if possible.
The battery shall power the pump for at least 4 hours without mains supply.
The battery shall power the pump for a sufficient time without mains supply.
The infusion pump shall display the remaining volume. It shall update every second.
The drug library shall be sent to the pump over an encrypted connection.
The infusion pump shall maximize battery life.
The infusion pump shall stop the infusion when the door is opened.
The door controller shall keep all passenger doors locked while the train speed is above 3 km/h.
The door controller shall allow the passenger doors to open at speeds below 8 km/h.
The doors shall close quickly.
The door controller shall detect an obstacle of 30 mm or larger between closing door leaves.
The door controller shall reopen the door when an obstacle is detected, as far as practicable.
The doors shall not open on the side away from the platform.
The door status shall be shown to the driver on the cab display.
The door controller shall report its status to the train control system every 500 ms.
The door controller must keep all passenger doors locked when the train is moving faster than 3 km/h.
The door system will be maintained by depot staff.
The flight controller shall return the drone to its launch point when the battery charge drops below 20%.
The flight controller shall land the drone when the battery charge drops below 10%.
The drone shall fly as long as possible.
The flight controller shall hold altitude within ±0.5 m in winds up to 10 m/s.
The flight controller shall hold altitude within ±2 m in winds up to 10 m/s.
The camera gimbal shall be stabilised.
The ground station shall show the drone's position, altitude, speed and so on.
The drone should avoid obstacles.
The flight controller shall never exceed an altitude of 120 m above ground level.
The flight controller shall always log GPS position at 10 Hz.
The portal shall load the dashboard within 2 s for 95% of requests at 500 concurrent users.
The portal shall be fast.
The portal shall support login with username and password as well as single sign-on.
The portal shall lock a user account after 5 failed login attempts.
The portal shall lock a user account after 3 failed login attempts.
Passwords shall be stored as salted hashes.
The portal shall provide an intuitive user interface.
The portal shall export reports in PDF, CSV, etc.
The portal shall be available 99.9% of the time per calendar month.
The portal should support mobile browsers.
Users shall be able to reset their password by email.
After five unsuccessful login attempts the portal shall lock the user account.
The portal shall use the Fast Identity Online (FIDO2) standard for passkeys.
The portal shall keep audit logs for some time.
The BMS shall disconnect the battery when any cell voltage exceeds 4.25 V.
The BMS shall disconnect the battery when any cell voltage exceeds 4.35 V.
The BMS shall estimate the state of charge with an error of no more than 3%.
The BMS shall balance cells efficiently.
The BMS shall measure each cell temperature at least once per second.
Cell temperatures shall be kept below 60 °C during charging.
The BMS shall not allow charging below 0 °C.
The BMS shall report state of charge, state of health and/or cell voltages to the vehicle controller.
The BMS shall minimise balancing losses.
The BMS shall open the main contactor if any cell voltage rises above 4.25 V.
The HVAC controller shall keep the office temperature between 20 °C and 24 °C during working hours.
The HVAC controller shall keep the office temperature at a comfortable level.
The HVAC controller shall switch to night mode at 20:00 and switch back to day mode at 06:00.
The HVAC controller shall reduce fan speed where feasible.
Filter replacement shall be signalled after 2000 operating hours.
The HVAC controller shall log energy use every 15 minutes.
The HVAC system shall be energy efficient.
The HVAC controller shall respond to setpoint changes in a timely manner.
The on-board computer shall switch to safe mode within 10 s of detecting a power bus undervoltage.
The on-board computer shall downlink housekeeping telemetry every 60 s.
Housekeeping telemetry shall be downlinked every 30 s.
The attitude control system shall point the payload with an accuracy of 0.1 degrees.
The on-board software shall be robust against single event upsets.
The on-board computer shall store telemetry when it has no ground contact.
The on-board computer shall support the maximum data rate of the transceiver.
The solar array drive shall track the sun.
The ATM shall dispense cash within 10 s of a confirmed withdrawal.
The ATM shall retain the card after 3 wrong PIN entries.
The card shall be retained after three wrong PIN entries.
The ATM shall print a receipt if necessary.
The ATM shall support many languages.
The ATM shall not dispense more than EUR 1000 per day per card.
The ATM shall display the balance.
The ATM display shall be readable in direct sunlight.
The robot controller shall stop all axes within 100 ms when the light curtain is interrupted.
The robot shall move at a safe speed near operators.
The robot controller shall limit tool speed to 250 mm/s in collaborative mode.
The robot controller shall limit tool speed to 500 mm/s in collaborative mode.
Emergency stop signals shall be processed with the highest priority.
The robot controller shall record each collision and the joint torques at that moment.
The robot shall be programmable by operators, maintenance staff, etc.
The system logs all user actions.
The application may cache results for up to 24 hours.
The system shall perform adequately under normal load.
The system shall support approximately 1000 users.
